name: junction
description: Junction — local AI coding agent bridge for OpenClaw, Hermes, and Souveraine

enumDescriptions: Enter sends; Shift+Enter inserts a newline
Ctrl/Cmd+Enter sends; Enter inserts a newline
Enter sends on a single line; multiline requires Ctrl/Cmd+Enter
junction.sendBehavior.description: How the chat composer submits a message.

enumDescriptions: Use the per-bridge setting (or queue if not set)
Hold the message until the current run finishes, then send
Inject the message into the running turn (needs gateway support; falls back to queue)
Stop the current run, then send the new message
junction.followUpMode.description: Global follow-up mode. Per-bridge overrides: junction.openclaw.followUpMode, junction.hermes.followUpMode, junction.souveraine.followUpMode.

enumDescriptions: Compact chat stream with activity folded into summary accordions.
Timeline chat stream with chronological reasoning/activity flow. Also enables the orange theme.

junction.checkpoints.enabled.description: Snapshot the workspace at each turn so you can 'Rewind code to here' (uses a shadow git repo in extension storage, never your real .git).

junction.beta.openclawForkRewind.description: Show beta Fork and Rewind buttons. Tested only with OpenClaw; leave off for other bridges.

junction.sandboxMode.description: Local UI preference for agent sandbox display. Applied only when the active bridge supports a matching control surface.

junction.approvalMode.description: Local UI preference for approval display. Applied only when the active bridge supports a matching control surface.

junction.extraRichText.description: Enable Pretext-powered extra-rich text rendering with animated text effects (matrix scroll, typewriter, etc.). Uses canvas-based text layout for smoother animations.

junction.goodFonts.description: Use the bundled "Good Fonts" pack — Comic Neue for regular text and Liga Comic Mono for monospace/code.

junction.todoCodeLensEnabled.description: Show CodeLens actions above TODO/FIXME/HACK comments to send them to Junction.

junction.activityStream.rail.description: Show the vertical guide line beside activity rows in timeline mode.

junction.activityStream.condensed.description: Group consecutive file edits into compact sections (one per file) instead of showing each edit as a separate row.

enumDescriptions: Colored status dots (green success, red error, blinking while running)
Neutral dots with a spinner while running
junction.activityStream.dots.description: Status indicator style on activity rows.

junction.bubble.radius.description: User message bubble corner radius. 0 = hard edges, 16 = default round, 999 = fully circular.

enumDescriptions: No pointed tip — full round corners
junction.bubble.tip.description: Position of the pointed tail on user message bubbles.

junction.steerKeybinding.description: Custom keybinding to steer in-flight runs (e.g., 'Ctrl+Shift+Enter'). Left empty by default (unbound).

junction.showFullHistory.description: Show full chat history on load (locally installed OpenClaw instances only). When enabled, loads up to 1000 messages instead of the default 200. May be slower on large sessions.

junction.autoSendFileContext.description: Automatically stage active editor context when switching files. Explicit file pills are still sent normally.

junction.fileContextInterval.description: Interval (in ms) for automatically staging editor context.

junction.openclaw.gatewayUrl.description: WebSocket URL of the OpenClaw runtime.

junction.openclaw.configPath.description: Path to the openclaw.json config file for the selected OpenClaw runtime.

junction.openclaw.followUpMode.description: Follow-up mode for OpenClaw. 'default' uses the global junction.followUpMode.

junction.hermes.dashboardUrl.description: Local Hermes dashboard URL used for native WebSocket integration.

junction.hermes.wsUrl.description: Local Hermes dashboard JSON-RPC WebSocket URL.

junction.hermes.apiBaseUrl.description: Local Hermes API server URL for REST fallback/status.

junction.hermes.home.description: Hermes home used for the managed hermling test runtime.

junction.hermes.repoPath.description: Path to the hermes-agent repo for managed spawn (leave empty to disable managed spawn).

junction.hermes.followUpMode.description: Follow-up mode for Hermes. 'default' uses the global junction.followUpMode.

junction.souveraine.home.description: HOME directory used for the managed souvieling test runtime.

junction.souveraine.repoPath.description: Path to the Souveraine repo for managed spawn (leave empty to disable managed spawn).

junction.souveraine.followUpMode.description: Follow-up mode for Souveraine. 'default' uses the global junction.followUpMode.

junction.mimocode.serverUrl.description: Connect to an already-running MiMoCode server (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080). Leave empty to let Junction spawn and manage its own instance.

junction.mimocode.binaryPath.description: Path to the mimo binary. Use "mimo" if it is on PATH, or set the full path (e.g. /home/user/bin/mimo).

junction.mimocode.port.description: Port for the managed MiMoCode server (0 = auto-assign random port). Ignored when junction.mimocode.serverUrl is set.

junction.mimocode.home.description: Data directory for Junction-managed MiMoCode state

junction.mimocode.followUpMode.description: MiMoCode follow-up mode preference (overrides junction.followUpMode when active bridge is MiMoCode)

junction.goose.serverUrl.description: Goose ACP server URL. Leave empty to auto-detect from localhost:3284.

junction.goose.home.description: Goose data directory. Leave empty for auto-detection (~/.goose).

junction.goose.binaryPath.description: Path to goose binary. Leave empty to auto-detect from PATH.

junction.goose.secretKey.description: Optional X-Secret-Key for a goosed server. Point junction.goose.serverUrl at a goosed instance for full model/command/history support.

junction.opencode.serverUrl.description: Connect to an already-running `opencode serve` (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:4096). Leave empty to let Junction spawn and manage its own opencode server.

junction.opencode.binaryPath.description: Path to the opencode binary. Leave empty to auto-detect (~/bin/opencode, then PATH).

junction.opencode.port.description: Port for the managed opencode server (0 = auto-assign). Ignored when junction.opencode.serverUrl is set.

junction.opencode.home.description: opencode config home (sets OPENCODE_CONFIG). Leave empty for the opencode default (~/.config/opencode).

junction.opencode.followUpMode.description: Follow-up mode for opencode. 'default' uses the global junction.followUpMode.

junction.openhands.serverUrl.description: OpenHands app server URL. Junction will spawn the managed server (junction.openhands.binaryPath) if this URL is unreachable.

junction.openhands.binaryPath.description: Path to the openhands server launcher. Leave empty to auto-detect (~/bin/openhands).

junction.openhands.home.description: OpenHands data/home directory (sets OPENHANDS_HOME). Leave empty for the OpenHands default (~/.openhands).

junction.openhands.repoPath.description: Path to the openhands repo for managed spawn (cwd for the launcher).

junction.openhands.followUpMode.description: Follow-up mode for OpenHands. 'default' uses the global junction.followUpMode.
